capabilities: Open a random note from the vault
Weight selection toward notes with older frontmatter dates
Write the current time to the weight property on open
Configure weight intensity and date format
disambiguation: Does not reorder or shuffle the vault's notes; each trigger opens a single randomly chosen note.
extras: Weighted mode depends on a frontmatter date property (e.g. updated, created) and a Moment.js date format string. Installation is manual: copy main.js, styles.css and manifest.json into .obsidian/plugins/random-note-shuffle/. README has no screenshots or troubleshooting.
intentEvidence: Open a random note from your Obsidian vault with optional weighted spaced repetition.
problem: Obsidian's built-in random note picks every note with equal probability, so old or forgotten notes are no more likely to resurface than ones just read.
summary: Random note opener that can weight selection toward notes with older frontmatter dates for spaced-repetition style revisiting.
